introHtml: At 42 ounces, these bar wine vessels offer a generous capacity ideal for serving large pours or sharing bottles at corporate events, trade shows, and hospitality venues. Unlike standard 12-15 oz wine glasses, a 42 oz option reduces the need for frequent refills, making it practical for busy receptions or outdoor gatherings. Customize with your logo through screen printing or etching for a durable, professional look that stands out in any setting.
